title: Adding the external Postgres metadata plugin introduced FilterEngine.create_postgres_query(), which str.format()s DID-search filter keys and values from the REST API straight into raw SQL.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: The new ExternalPostgresJSONDidMeta plugin implements get_metadata/set_metadata/set_metadata_bulk/delete_metadata/list_dids and, via manages_key()=True, intercepts metadata traffic routed through the dispatcher. Its queries key only on scope/name (and scope+vo), with no owner, account, or VO membership verification. Unlike the Rucio core API path (api/did.py) which calls permission.has_permission

get_metadata builds SQL by string formatting user-controllable DID scope/name values (from the request) directly into a SELECT statement and executes it with psycopg2, with no bound parameters and no escaping/allowlist.

set_metadata_bulk formats user-controllable scope/name values and json.dumps(meta) (attacker-controlled key and value from the request) directly into an INSERT statement and executes it, with no bound parameters.
delete_metadata formats the user-controllable metadata key (request input) directly into an UPDATE statement's jsonb-delete expression and executes it, with no bound parameters or escaping.

list_dids splices an unescaped SQL fragment (postgres_query_str) into a SELECT that is executed with psycopg2. The fragment is built by FilterEngine.create_postgres_query (newly added in this PR) which string-formats user-supplied filter keys, values, and wildcards into the WHERE clause without parameterization, allowing injection of arbitrary SQL.

The new create_postgres_query() builds PostgreSQL SQL text with .format() from user-controlled filter `key` and `value` (from the DID listing filters, passed to FilterEngine with strict_coerce=False, so keys are never validated/allowlisted and remain raw strings). The resulting string is placed directly into a SELECT executed via cur.execute() with no bound parameters and no quoting/escaping of si

The new test class TestDidMetaExternalPostgresJSON (lib/rucio/tests/test_did_meta_plugins.py) drives ExternalPostgresJSONDidMeta.set_metadata / list_dids with attacker-influenceable values (meta keys and values) and executes them against a real PostgreSQL server. These methods build SQL via string concatenation with no binding and no identifier allowlist: set_metadata_bulk inlines the JSON-payload

findings.explanation: The new ExternalPostgresJSONDidMeta plugin implements get_metadata/set_metadata/set_metadata_bulk/delete_metadata/list_dids and, via manages_key()=True, intercepts metadata traffic routed through the dispatcher. Its queries key only on scope/name (and scope+vo), with no owner, account, or VO membership verification. Unlike the Rucio core API path (api/did.py) which calls permission.has_permission before mutating operations, this plugin performs reads and writes with no authentication or role check, exposing metadata of any DID in an enabled VO to any caller once the plugin is wired in via the [metadata] 'plugins' config (METADATA_PLUGIN_MODULES).

findings.suggested_fix: Do not concatenate user-controlled keys/values into SQL text. Use a parameterized query (psycopg2 %s placeholders with a params tuple) for all values, and validate/allowlist every identifier (column names, jsonb path keys) against a strict set before interpolation. For JSONB path keys, use an allowlist of known metadata keys or the safe ->> identifier form with a validated identifier, and never pass raw filter values into the format string.

findings.explanation: The new test class TestDidMetaExternalPostgresJSON (lib/rucio/tests/test_did_meta_plugins.py) drives ExternalPostgresJSONDidMeta.set_metadata / list_dids with attacker-influenceable values (meta keys and values) and executes them against a real PostgreSQL server. These methods build SQL via string concatenation with no binding and no identifier allowlist: set_metadata_bulk inlines the JSON-payload values directly into an INSERT ... VALUES (...) (the values can carry a single quote to close the literal and append arbitrary SQL), list_dids passes filter keys and values through FilterEngine.create_postgres_query which builds clauses of the form "data->>'<key>' <op> '<value>'" and "<key> <op> '<value>'" with the key and value interpolated verbatim (only the wildcard/underscore is escaped), and get_metadata inlines scope/name the same way. Because the new test code is what newly exercises this unsafe execution path, the section exposes the injection.

Rucio - Scientific Data Management
==================================

Rucio is a software framework that provides functionality to organize, manage, and access large volumes of scientific data using customisable policies. The data can be spread across globally distributed locations and across heterogeneous data centers, uniting different storage and network technologies as a single federated entity. Rucio offers advanced features such as distributed data recovery or adaptive replication, and is highly scalable, modular, and extensible.
